newsitem.title: USA: Westinghouse silent on spinoff report.
newsitem.headline: Westinghouse silent on spinoff report.

text.p: Westinghouse Electric Corp on Tuesday declined comment on a published report that it plans to spin off its industrial businesses into a separate company.
Westinghouse spokeswoman Mimi Limbach also declined comment on whether the strategy would be announced publicly on Wednesday.
The Wall Street Journal said Westinghouse directors would meet on Tuesday and were expected to approve a spinoff of the industrial operations into a new company with a separately traded stock.
The report said the spinoff could be announced tomorrow.
